# Piece Format Reference

A piece defines a portable unit of programmable graphics with `piece.toml` and up to three WGSL files (`common.wgsl`, `derive.wgsl`, `draw.wgsl`).
Library pieces, workspace pieces, and inline `[[piece]]` entries in a spec share one schema, one manifest validator, and one SHA-256 content hash.
The script `scripts/generate_piece_reference.py` generates this page from `piece.h`, `pieces.h`, `piece_checks.cpp`, and `caliper-spec-v2.schema.json`.
Continuous integration runs `python scripts/generate_piece_reference.py --check` and fails when this page drifts from those sources.
Run `python3 scripts/generate_piece_reference.py --write` after any change to piece limits, manifest schema keys, or check codes.

## Schema Definitions

The canonical JSON Schema in `src/builder/spec/schema/caliper-spec-v2.schema.json` validates piece keys, types, patterns, and array bounds.
Tensor inputs accept element types `f32`, `i32`, `u32`, `u8`, `u16`, or distinct combinations joined by `|`.
Texture resources accept formats `rgba8unorm`, `r8unorm`, `r32uint`.
See [Pieces](../agents/pieces.md) for authoring workflows and [MCP Command Reference](mcp-commands.md#piece-library-commands) for `piece.*` tools.

### Manifest Root Keys

Top-level keys in `piece.toml` or an inline `[[piece]]` table.

| Key | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Yes | pattern `^\[a-z\]\[a-z0-9_\]{0,31}$` |
| `version` | `integer` | No | range `1` to `1000000` |
| `description` | `string` | No | max length `256` |
| `inputs` | array of `piece_input` | No | max items `8` |
| `params` | array of `piece_param` | No | max items `16` |
| `resources` | array of `piece_resource` | No | max items `8` |
| `imports` | array of `string` | No | max items `8`; item pattern `^\[a-z\]\[a-z0-9_\]{0,31}@\[1-9\]\[0-9\]{0,5}$` |
| `depends` | array of `object` | No | max items `8` |
| `derive` | `piece_derive` | No | None |
| `draw` | `piece_draw` | No | None |
| `sample` | array of `object` | No | max items `8` |
| `hash` | `string` | No | pattern `^sha256:\[0-9a-f\]{64}$` |
| `files` | `object` | No | None |

### Input Table Keys

Keys of each `[[inputs]]` entry for derive tensors and draw buffer inputs.

| Key | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Yes | pattern `^\[a-z\]\[a-z0-9_\]{0,31}$` |
| `kind` | `string` | Yes | enum: `tensor`, `buffer` |
| `dtype` | `string` | No | pattern `^(f32\|i32\|u32\|u8\|u16)(\\|(f32\|i32\|u32\|u8\|u16)){0,4}$` |
| `rank_min` | `integer` | No | range `0` to `8` |
| `rank_max` | `integer` | No | range `0` to `8` |
| `element` | `string` | No | enum: `f32`, `i32`, `u32`, `vec2&lt;f32&gt;`, `vec4&lt;f32&gt;`, `vec2&lt;u32&gt;`, `vec4&lt;u32&gt;`, `u8`, `u16` |
| `struct` | `string` | No | pattern `^\[A-Z\]\[A-Za-z0-9_\]{0,31}$` |
| `fields` | array of `string` | No | items `1` to `16`; item pattern `^\[a-z_\]\[a-z0-9_\]{0,31}: (f32\|i32\|u32\|vec2&lt;f32&gt;\|vec4&lt;f32&gt;\|vec2&lt;u32&gt;\|vec4&lt;u32&gt;)$` |
| `title` | `string` | No | length `1` to `256` |
| `optional` | `boolean` | No | None |

### Parameter Table Keys

Keys of each `[[params]]` entry in the generated `Params` uniform struct.

| Key | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Yes | pattern `^\[a-z\]\[a-z0-9_\]{0,31}$` |
| `type` | `string` | No | enum: `f32`, `i32`, `u32` |
| `default` | `number` | No | None |
| `min` | `number` | No | None |
| `max` | `number` | No | None |
| `title` | `string` | No | length `1` to `256` |

Keys of each `[[resources]]` entry for published or private buffers and textures.

| Key | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | Yes | pattern `^\[a-z\]\[a-z0-9_\]{0,31}$` |
| `kind` | `string` | Yes | enum: `buffer`, `texture` |
| `element` | `string` | No | enum: `f32`, `i32`, `u32`, `vec2&lt;f32&gt;`, `vec4&lt;f32&gt;`, `vec2&lt;u32&gt;`, `vec4&lt;u32&gt;`, `u8`, `u16` |
| `struct` | `string` | No | pattern `^\[A-Z\]\[A-Za-z0-9_\]{0,31}$` |
| `fields` | array of `string` | No | items `1` to `16`; item pattern `^\[a-z_\]\[a-z0-9_\]{0,31}: (f32\|i32\|u32\|vec2&lt;f32&gt;\|vec4&lt;f32&gt;\|vec2&lt;u32&gt;\|vec4&lt;u32&gt;)$` |
| `count` | `integer` | No | range `1` to `134217728` |
| `counted` | `boolean` | No | None |
| `width` | `integer` | No | range `1` to `8192` |
| `height` | `integer` | No | range `1` to `8192` |
| `format` | `string` | No | enum: `rgba8unorm`, `r8unorm`, `r32uint` |
| `texels` | `integer` | No | range `1` to `67108864` |

### Derive Table Keys

Keys of the `[derive]` compute table that runs in the producer on `caliper.step()`.

| Key | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `passes` | array of `object` | Yes | items `1` to `8` |
| `time_ms` | `number` | No | range `0.01` to `50` |
| `memory_mb` | `integer` | No | range `1` to `512` |
| `every` | `integer` | No | range `1` to `10000` |

### Draw Table Keys

Keys of the `[draw]` table that runs each viewer frame on Metal, Vulkan, or WebGPU.

|---|---|---|---|
| `camera` | `string` | No | enum: `orbit`, `pan_zoom`, `none` |
| `buffers` | array of `object` | No | max items `4` |
| `targets` | array of `object` | No | max items `4` |
| `passes` | array of `piece_draw_pass` | Yes | items `1` to `16` |
| `pick` | `object` | No | None |
| `text` | `object` | No | None |
| `frame_ms` | `number` | No | range `0.1` to `16` |
| `memory_mb` | `integer` | No | range `1` to `512` |

| `reads` | array of `string` | No | max items `4`; item pattern `^\[a-z\]\[a-z0-9_\]{0,31}$` |
| `instances` | `integer` | `string` | No | None |

## Quantitative Limits

Every limit in `caliper_builder::spec::piece_limits` (`src/builder/include/caliper_builder/spec/piece.h`) bounds memory, pass counts, and WebGPU bindings.
The manifest validator in `src/builder/programs/piece_checks.cpp` checks every product in 64-bit arithmetic before buffer allocation.

| Constant | Limit | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| `kNameMax` | `32` | \[a-z\]\[a-z0-9_\]{0,31} |
| `kVersionMax` | `1,000,000` | Piece limit |
| `kDescriptionMax` | `256` | Piece limit |
| `kInputs` | `8` | tensors and buffers that a piece reads |
| `kParams` | `16` | Piece limit |
| `kResources` | `8` | published or private resources of a piece |
| `kImports` | `8` | lib modules |
| `kDepends` | `8` | Piece limit |
| `kFields` | `16` | fields of one layout |
| `kStrideMax` | `256` | bytes of one element |
| `kCountMax` | `33,554,432` | elements of one buffer: 128 MiB of 4-byte elements |
| `kTextureSideMax` | `8,192` | pixels of one texture side: WebGPU's default |
| `kResourceBytesMax` | `67,108,864 (64 MiB)` | bytes of one private resource or draw buffer |
| `kPublishedResourceBytesMax` | `134,217,728 (128 MiB)` | Published buffers retain WebGPU's 128 MiB storage binding limit. Textures can hold every texel of an 8,192 by 8,192 RGBA8 or R32 image, 256 MiB. |
| `kPublishedTextureBytesMax` | `268,435,456 (256 MiB)` | Piece limit |
| `kPublishedBytesMax` | `536,870,912 (512 MiB)` | Bytes of all published resources of a piece together, 512 MiB: one version of each fits the step history's resource budget. A version above 8 MiB goes to a viewer in parts of 8 MiB, each while the viewer's queue holds at most 8 MiB and 64 KiB, half of the 16 MiB control queue of either sender (python/caliper/_programs.py, PUBLISHED_BYTES_MAX, PART_BYTES and RESOURCE_BACKLOG_BYTES). |
| `kKeepDefault` | `256` | kept versions of a resource in the step history |
| `kKeepMax` | `4,096` | Piece limit |
| `kDerivePasses` | `8` | Piece limit |
| `kDrawPasses` | `16` | Piece limit |
| `kDrawBuffers` | `4` | buffers that the draw half keeps between frames |
| `kTargets` | `4` | offscreen targets |
| `kFileBytes` | `65,536` | each WGSL file |
| `kSampleBytes` | `1,048,576 (1 MiB)` | all sample files of a piece |
| `kInstancesMax` | `4,194,304` | Piece limit |
| `kVerticesMax` | `65,536` | vertices of one instance |
| `kWorkgroupsMax` | `65,535` | each of three dispatch counts |
| `kFrameMsDefault` | `4.0` | GPU time of the draw half in one frame |
| `kFrameMsMax` | `16.0` | Piece limit |
| `kDrawMemoryMbDefault` | `64` | resources, draw buffers and targets in the viewer |
| `kDrawMemoryMbMax` | `512` | Piece limit |
| `kPickFields` | `8` | Piece limit |
| `kStrings` | `4,096` | strings of the literal text table |
| `kBufferStrings` | `8,224` | reference nodes plus token labels |
| `kStringBytes` | `64` | Piece limit |
| `kLabels` | `512` | labels drawn in one frame, as place_labels |

## Composed Module Bindings

Piece WGSL files never declare `@group` or `@binding` attributes because the composer generates all bindings from `piece.toml`.
The constants in `src/builder/include/caliper_builder/programs/pieces.h` fix the bind group and prelude layout across Metal, Vulkan, and WebGPU.

| Constant | Value | Binding Role |
|---|---:|---|
| `kPreludeVersion` | `1` | Composer constant |
| `kGroupPrelude` | `0` | draw: the prelude and params; derive: caliper, params, shapes |
| `kGroupInputs` | `1` | derive: the tensors; draw: counts, resources, buffer inputs |
| `kGroupResources` | `2` | derive: resources and counters; draw: draw buffers, read targets |
| `kBindingView` | `0` | var&lt;uniform&gt; caliper_view: CaliperView |
| `kBindingSelection` | `1` | var&lt;storage, read&gt; caliper_selection |
| `kBindingLinear` | `2` | caliper_linear: sampler |
| `kBindingNearest` | `3` | caliper_nearest: sampler |
| `kBindingColormaps` | `4` | caliper_colormaps: texture_2d&lt;f32&gt; |
| `kBindingParams` | `5` | var&lt;uniform&gt; params: Params, when the piece has params |
| `kViewBytes` | `288` | the size of CaliperView |
| `kSelectedBytes` | `32` | the size of CaliperSelected |
| `kMaxSelected` | `256` | entries of caliper_selection |

## Validation and Host Refusal Codes

The composer, manifest validator (`piece_checks.cpp`), WGSL reflection checker, and host runtimes return structured `piece.*` and `program.*` codes.

| Code | Constant | Stage | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `program.not_built` | `kProgramNotBuilt` | Composer and reflection | A part of programmable graphics that this build does not have yet. |
| `piece.bad_name` | `kPieceBadName` | Composer and reflection | a name or version outside its form |
| `piece.bad_manifest` | `kPieceBadManifest` | Manifest check | a key, count or value of piece.toml |
| `piece.bad_path` | `kPieceBadPath` | Manifest check | a file outside its folder, a link, or another name |
| `piece.unknown_import` | `kPieceUnknownImport` | Manifest check | no such lib module, or m::item names none |
| `piece.not_found` | `kPieceNotFound` | Composer and reflection | a command names no such piece |
| `piece.missing` | `kPieceMissing` | Composer and reflection | a program pins a piece that its source lacks |
| `piece.hash_mismatch` | `kPieceHashMismatch` | Composer and reflection | the pinned hash differs from the piece's |
| `piece.exists` | `kPieceExists` | Composer and reflection | that name and version exist in the workspace |
| `piece.read_only` | `kPieceReadOnly` | Composer and reflection | a library piece |
| `piece.in_use` | `kPieceInUse` | Composer and reflection | the open spec pins that version |
| `piece.bad_binding` | `kPieceBadBinding` | Manifest check | an input unbound, or bound to another dtype, rank or layout |
| `piece.cycle` | `kPieceCycle` | Manifest check | buffer inputs of programs form a cycle |
| `program.form_mixed` | `kProgramFormMixed` | Composer and reflection | keys of the one-pass form and a pin |
| `program.bad_resource` | `kProgramBadResource` | Manifest check | kind, count, size or a duplicate id |
| `program.bad_layout` | `kProgramBadLayout` | Manifest check | a field's name or type, or a stride |
| `program.unknown_resource` | `kProgramUnknownResource` | Manifest check | a pass, a pick or a text names none |
| `program.bad_pass` | `kProgramBadPass` | Manifest check | a pass's kind, entry, target or values |
| `program.target_cycle` | `kProgramTargetCycle` | Manifest check | a pass reads its own target, or before a write |
| `program.bad_pick` | `kProgramBadPick` | Manifest check | the item map names no field or no pick pass |
| `program.bad_text` | `kProgramBadText` | Manifest check | the text table's anchors or strings |
| `program.camera_conflict` | `kProgramCameraConflict` | Composer and reflection | two programs of a panel select two cameras |
| `program.binding_not_allowed` | `kProgramBindingNotAllowed` | Composer and reflection | a file declares @group or @binding |
| `program.reserved_name` | `kProgramReservedName` | Composer and reflection | a caliper_ or Caliper name, or a name with "__" |
| `program.entry_stage` | `kProgramEntryStage` | Composer and reflection | an entry point of the wrong stage, or none |
| `program.interface_mismatch` | `kProgramInterfaceMismatch` | Composer and reflection | stage interfaces, or a fragment's outputs and its target, disagree |
| `program.over_web_limits` | `kProgramOverWebLimits` | Manifest check | over a default limit of WebGPU |
| `program.workgroup_memory` | `kProgramWorkgroupMemory` | Composer and reflection | a compute entry uses var&lt;workgroup&gt; |
| `program.resources_unavailable` | `kProgramResourcesUnavailable` | Host runtime | no capability "resources" |
| `program.resource_too_large` | `kProgramResourceTooLarge` | Host runtime | a version over its bytes |
| `program.draw_over_time` | `kProgramDrawOverTime` | Host runtime | over frame_ms for 30 frames in a row |
| `program.draw_timeout` | `kProgramDrawTimeout` | Host runtime | a frame not done after 1 s |
| `program.draw_over_memory` | `kProgramDrawOverMemory` | Host runtime | over draw.memory_mb |
| `program.browser_refused` | `kProgramBrowserRefused` | Host runtime | WebGPU refused a module or a pipeline |
